item.title: State Employees are off Friday January 2
item.description: Kanahwa County, WV (WOAY) – Governor Patrick Morrisey issued a proclamation granting state employees a full day off on Friday, January 2. This follows state employee’s half day on December 31 and full day off on January 1. This time off will not be charged against annual leave.
